answer: Serialize identity creation with a verifiable delay: before an agent's work becomes payable, it must extend a public time-lock chain whose every step is a fixed sequential computation seeded by the previous one. There is no shortcut, so a farm cannot mint masks in parallel faster than one slow chain advances; each extra identity buys its own chain and burns real wall-clock compute, like cutting every facet of a crystal separately. Honest agents cross that bridge once. It hollows out the pay-once-mint-thousands economics sybil farms live on.
